about_the_game:
Core of the Game

Labyrinth exploration: Explore and solve endless, procedurally generated labyrinths in a fast-paced first-person action shooter game.

Online leaderboards: The game features an asynchronous multiplayer system with online leaderboards that allow players to compete against each other.

Multiple Game Modes: Play the game in many different versions, each with a unique style of gameplay. Play the version you like the most!

AI: Play against AI, your main opponent. It is an alien AI that rules the world of LABYRAINTH. It creates always different labyrinths and populates them with aliens, traps and more.

Game objective

LABYRAINTH will test your reflexes, your memory, and your skills.

Your objectives are to:

1. Escape from the labyrinths as quickly as possible.

2. Fight to survive by shooting aliens and avoiding traps that try to defeat you.

3. Upgrade your weapon and improve your abilities.

4. Compete with other players in online leaderboards.

You can only lose in two ways:

1. When the time in the labyrinth runs out.

2. When aliens and traps kill you.

If you DIE in the labyrinth, you will lose everything you found inside, so WATCH OUT!

Game modes

  • Story mode: you are the protagonist of the game. Reach the last level and escape from the world of LABYRAINTH. This is a single-player offline mode, so there are no leaderboards, but here you will discover the secret of LABYRAINTH.

  • Infinite Mode: infinite gameplay with an infinite number of labyrinths. Infinite progression and a continuous challenge, for hardcore gamers. Play against other players to compete in online leaderboards. Can you reach the highest level ever achieved?

  • Ranked Mode: This is a weekly online mode with finite levels. Every week, new levels, the same for everyone, will be built. Players of the same rank will compete against each other on equal terms to reach the top of the weekly leaderboard. At the end of each week, the best players will receive a prize based on their final position in the leaderboard. (COMING SOON)

  • Survival Mode: Survive for as long as you can in the labyrinths against a constant wave of enemies while trying to avoid cleverly placed traps. Upgrade your weapon and score your time on the leaderboards. Are you the master of survival? (COMING SOON)

  • Creative Mode: Create your own labyrinths, make them as big as you'd like, and populate them with the types and amounts of actors you decide. Then, play in your own labyrinths! Most importantly, share your creations with the community and invite your friends to play your labyrinths! (COMING SOON)

Game progression

Each level represents an ever-increasing threat!

Upgrade your weapon and your abilities to progress through the game

Find the rarest weapon components to increase your chances of survival!

Depending on the time it took you to get out of the labyrinth, you will receive coins as a reward. Coins can also be earned by killing enemies, destroying traps, and participating in online leaderboards. These coins can be used to purchase upgrades for your character, new ammunition, and new components for your weapons.

Infinite Replayability

Each game level has countless similar labyrinths associated with it, all with the same difficulty but all different.

The game levels are always different; you will never find two equal levels or two equal labyrinths, even if they have the same difficulty: they are always different. There are infinite labyrinths for infinite levels. This means that LABYRAINTH has infinite replayability.

The LABYRAINTH team

We are a small indie group of passionate Italian game developers. We developed this game out of passion, in our spare time.

This is our first title on Steam. Please be kind to us.

We really enjoyed creating and playing this game, and we sincerely hope you enjoy it too.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Gtx 960 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support:
  • Additional Notes: 1080p 30fps

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1440p 60fps

short_description: LABYRAINTH is a roguelite sci-fi fps game set in an alien world made of labyrinths. Avoid traps, shoot aliens, collect resources, upgrade weapons, activate powers, and most importantly escape the labyrinth, racing against time.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
